div.div:
CASE INVARIANTS (Section 5.1 / ADR-002):
• Alert Deduplication: Alerts on a plot with an open case join its alert_refs; no duplicate case is opened (ASM-141).
• Mode Boundary: Plot enters Precision Mode on case opening. Returns to Area Mode ONLY on terminal closure (closed or closed_without_fumigation).
• Closure Guard: If verification object or track never arrives, case stays in verifying (open) and A21 alarms report it.

Triggers:
• Agronomist rejects draft (ASM-142)
• window_end elapses in draft / authorized / dispatched
• Pilot permit revoked before flight (A09 sec 10)
• Drone kit revoked & window_end passes
Recovery:
Late flight record flown within window transitions to executed with late_record flag (ASM-142)

div.div:
FUMIGATION ORDER INVARIANTS (Section 5.2 / ADR-002):
• Human Authorization Mandatory: 'La autorización de fumigación es una identidad humana. Ningún disparador la ejecuta.' Function roles strictly denied.
• No-Signal Store-and-Forward: An order in flown does NOT expire at window_end: the flight occurred in window and sits in local buffer (PD-141).
• Executed State Flags: Order reaches executed on ANY persisted fumigation flight record. Flagged (not blocked) if: aborted_closure, out_of_window, batch_mismatch, or late_record (ASM-146).
• Order Closure: Moves to closed on ANY persisted verification result (both can_close and cannot_close close the order, ASM-141).

MANDATORY MISSION TYPES & S3 PREFIXES (Section 3 & 7):
• 1. Plot Delimitation (delimitation): Boundary & no-fly zone GeoJSON version.
• 2. Pest Confirmation (confirmation): Focus pass; triggers Bedrock confirmation.
• 3. Focalized Fumigation (fumigation): Requires human-authorized order.
• 4. Post-Fumigation Verification (verification): Closes case on clear signs.
• 5. Crop State Estimation (estimation): Scheduled campaign vitality assessment.
• Quarantine Isolation: Invalid grants/checksums routed to quarantine/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/.

div.div:
MISSION INVARIANTS (Section 5.3 / A15 / A17):
• Five Mandatory Services: 'Los cinco entran. No se sustituye uno por otro.' Types: delimitation, confirmation, fumigation, verification, estimation.
• Upload Quarantine: Objects failing grant/checksum checks go to quarantine/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/ and do NOT count toward persistence (PD-104).
• Inference Decoupling: Drone inference functions trigger on mission_record_persisted via DynamoDB Streams -> EventBridge, NEVER on raw S3 object arrival (ASM-149).
• Flight Without Persisted Record: A mission in dispatched or flown without a persisted record is flagged as unpersisted flight (Point 6 / A21).

div.div:
1. Agronomist Role (SR2/JR2 | Cognito staff MFA):
• Exclusive human authority for fumigation order authorization (ADR-002).
• Fresh Cognito MFA session required (auth_time <= 10 min, ASM-092).
• Authorizer ID captured strictly from JWT token; cannot be operator.
• Re-evaluates cases: closes without fumigation or triggers re-flight.
• Defines UTC execution window (window_start/end) & product_batch_id.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(203, 213, 225), rgb(47, 56, 66));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 962px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1500px; margin-left: 1036px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1e293b;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1e293b, #c3ccdc); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
2. Contracted Pilot & Drone Kit (A09 sec 6):
• Pilot in Cognito staff with MFA; Aerocivil permit verified (ASM-020).
• Drone Kit registered as AWS IoT Thing with X.509 certificate.
• Upload Grant: IoT MQTT grant restricts S3 PUTs to manifest keys.
• Preload: Mission package preloaded into Drone Kit before takeoff.
• Non-volatile encrypted buffer survives zero-signal flights; evicted on receipt.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(203, 213, 225), rgb(47, 56, 66));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 962px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1500px; margin-left: 2036px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1e293b;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1e293b, #c3ccdc); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
3. Event-Driven Inference (Part E / A17 / D10):
• Confirmation, Verification, Estimation invoke Amazon Bedrock Runtime.
• Model: Nova Pro in us-east-1 on-demand, zero-shot prompt (ASM-160).
• Trigger: DynamoDB Stream pipe to custom EventBridge bus (ASM-149).
• Bedrock output: Confidence in [0, 1] + structured pest_signs array.
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems; state unchanged on failure.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(203, 213, 225), rgb(47, 56, 66));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 962px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1500px; margin-left: 3036px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1e293b;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1e293b, #c3ccdc); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4. Case, Order & S3 Traceability (ASM-145, ASM-146):
• Storage: DynamoDB records table encrypted under KMS key 'records'.
• Retention: 5-year compliance lifecycle for all records & S3 objects.
• Flight Record: Mandatory flight closure ('completed' / 'aborted').
• Observability: A21 monitors unclosed fumigations, unflown orders,
and missions in dispatched/flown without persisted records.
